providing advanced solutions in aeration and mixing, biological processes, cloth media filtration,
membranes, PFAS solutions, disinfection and process control. As an applied engineering company
serving both municipal and industrial customers, we work collaboratively with consulting engineers,
owners, plant managers and operators to design and manufacture the best treatment solution with the
lowest lifecycle cost. Our “Customer for Life” philosophy ensures that every customer will receive
unparalleled service before, during and after the installation of Aqua-Aerobic products.

### Protecting the World's Water.

Since 1969, Aqua-Aerobic Systems, Inc. has led the water and wastewater treatment industry by
providing advanced solutions in aeration and mixing, biological processes, cloth media filtration,
membranes, PFAS solutions, disinfection and process control. As an applied engineering company
serving both municipal and industrial customers, we work collaboratively with consulting engineers,
owners, plant managers and operators to design and manufacture the best treatment solution with the
lowest lifecycle cost. Our “Customer for Life” philosophy ensures that every customer will receive
unparalleled service before, during and after the installation of Aqua-Aerobic products.

ingenuity, the physical and the digital. At Honeywell Technologies, we make these connections real,
turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.
[Multiple gas storage tanks are lined up, showcasing safety ladders and railings for secure access.]

## Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

## Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.
[Honeywell C300 product image]

customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes
improvements, and acts only with their approval.

# Welcome to Jacobs

# Moving what matters

From cities and corridors to ports and people, Jacobs delivers the infrastructure, innovation and
design that keeps the world moving. We do more than build transportation systems. We move people,
goods and communities — safely and efficiently. 

[Explore We Move][191]

## Reinventing tomorrow.

Jacobs is a global professional services company delivering science-based, digitally enabled,
end-to-end solutions — from consulting and advisory to design and implementation — across the
world’s most complex infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology
challenges.

We bring together the right services, expertise and technology to deliver forward-thinking and
sustainable solutions that are built to last.

OUR BRAND

Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group is one of the world’s leading industrial groups,
spanning energy,logistics & infrastructure, industrial machinery, aerospace and defense.
MHI Group combines cutting-edge technology with deep experience to deliver innovative, integrated
solutions
that help to realize a carbon neutral world, improve the quality of life and ensure a safer world.

[Outline of MHI Group][276]

OUR EXPERTISE

## FROM THE OCEAN
## TO OUTER SPACE

EFFICIENT & CLEAN ENERGY

As the leading supplier of power generation systems, MHI Group offers reliable and more sustainable
power to people around the globe. We provide gas turbines that achieve the world’s highest level of
thermal efficiency or more and have developed world-class boiler combustion technology. Furthermore,
we utilize cutting-edge digital technology to minimize CO2 emissions associated with power
generation.

SUPPORTING SAFE AND COMFORTABLE LIVING

MHI Group’s passion is to enrich people’s lives. Whether through producing energy efficient and easy
to clean home air conditioners or refrigeration units for trucks to deliver fresh foods around the
world, or centrifugal chillers that support the large-scale air-conditioning required in buildings,
hospitals, and event halls, we combine our technologies and our expertise to produce products to
ensure that the end beneficiaries enjoy the ultimate experience.

OUR BRAND

Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group is one of the world’s leading industrial groups,
spanning energy,logistics & infrastructure, industrial machinery, aerospace and defense.
MHI Group combines cutting-edge technology with deep experience to deliver innovative, integrated
solutions
that help to realize a carbon neutral world, improve the quality of life and ensure a safer world.

EFFICIENT & CLEAN ENERGY

As the leading supplier of power generation systems, MHI Group offers reliable and more sustainable
power to people around the globe. We provide gas turbines that achieve the world’s highest level of
thermal efficiency or more and have developed world-class boiler combustion technology. Furthermore,
we utilize cutting-edge digital technology to minimize CO2 emissions associated with power
generation.

SUPPORTING SAFE AND COMFORTABLE LIVING

MHI Group’s passion is to enrich people’s lives. Whether through producing energy efficient and easy
to clean home air conditioners or refrigeration units for trucks to deliver fresh foods around the
world, or centrifugal chillers that support the large-scale air-conditioning required in buildings,
hospitals, and event halls, we combine our technologies and our expertise to produce products to
ensure that the end beneficiaries enjoy the ultimate experience.

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.

# Our Difference

#### [Custom Design and Fabrication][69]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 19]

We offer in-house custom production including design, fabrication and installation of carbon steel,
stainless steel, aluminum and exotic alloys in our 35,000 square meter manufacturing facility
located at Mersin on the Mediterranean cost of Turkey.

We have especially chosen the temperate climate of the Mediterranean region for our products that
are exported directly to more than 80 countries.

With this way, all welding processes are always done above 0 degrees throughout the year. In
addition, thanks to our proximity to Mersin Port, our delivery times by sea are considerably
shortened.

#### [200+ Diverse Range Products][70]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 20]

Thanks to our two separate brands, Ergil and Storagetech, we have a product range of over 200.

We produce Tank equipment and Process equipment, which are closely related to each other, in the
same field. In this way, we can use our engineering know-how in industrial equipment and process
products together in a complementary way.

#### [In-House Engineering & Design][71]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 21]We offer in-house custom production including design,
fabrication and installation of carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum.

Äager’s main design office is in Mersin, Turkey, where a team of experienced professional engineers
design and supervise the construction of its client’s projects. A smaller engineering office is in
Dubai, and provides support to Äager’s teams and clients throughout the world.

The design team works with many Standards, including those of the API, ASME, EN, DIN, ISO and GOST
as specified by their client’s purchase order. They are supported by the use of verified current
computer-aided engineering (CAE), and computer-aided design (CAD) software programs

#### [35,000 Square Meter Manufacturing Facility][72]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 22]

Äager – Manufacturing and Engineering Company, brings 40 years of experience and knowledge in
manufacturing equipment and accessories of storage tank terminals, refineries, pipelines, process
and industrial plants.

Our vast experience enables us to bear and meet complex projects and deliver great quality of
service. Äager offers extensive machining capability, equipped with a wide variety of CNC mills,
lathes, cutting, bending, rolling and welding machines.

# Our Difference

#### [Custom Design and Fabrication][69]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 19]

We offer in-house custom production including design, fabrication and installation of carbon steel,
stainless steel, aluminum and exotic alloys in our 35,000 square meter manufacturing facility
located at Mersin on the Mediterranean cost of Turkey.

We have especially chosen the temperate climate of the Mediterranean region for our products that
are exported directly to more than 80 countries.

With this way, all welding processes are always done above 0 degrees throughout the year. In
addition, thanks to our proximity to Mersin Port, our delivery times by sea are considerably
shortened.

#### [200+ Diverse Range Products][70]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 20]

Thanks to our two separate brands, Ergil and Storagetech, we have a product range of over 200.

We produce Tank equipment and Process equipment, which are closely related to each other, in the
same field. In this way, we can use our engineering know-how in industrial equipment and process
products together in a complementary way.

#### [In-House Engineering & Design][71]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 21]We offer in-house custom production including design,
fabrication and installation of carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum.

Äager’s main design office is in Mersin, Turkey, where a team of experienced professional engineers
design and supervise the construction of its client’s projects. A smaller engineering office is in
Dubai, and provides support to Äager’s teams and clients throughout the world.

The design team works with many Standards, including those of the API, ASME, EN, DIN, ISO and GOST
as specified by their client’s purchase order. They are supported by the use of verified current
computer-aided engineering (CAE), and computer-aided design (CAD) software programs

#### [35,000 Square Meter Manufacturing Facility][72]

[Manufacturing and Engineering Company 22]

Äager – Manufacturing and Engineering Company, brings 40 years of experience and knowledge in
manufacturing equipment and accessories of storage tank terminals, refineries, pipelines, process
and industrial plants.

Our vast experience enables us to bear and meet complex projects and deliver great quality of
service. Äager offers extensive machining capability, equipped with a wide variety of CNC mills,
lathes, cutting, bending, rolling and welding machines.

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

## Over The Years

* Opened its 500th Store and its second Distribution Center in Marilao, Bulacan.
* Expanded in more areas including Makati, Mandaluyong, Malabon, Navotas, Valenzuela, Pampanga and
  Nueva Ecija.
* Received the Golden Globe Annual Awards for Business Excellence.
[year image]

[year image]

* Opened its fourth Distribution Center (Silang, Cavite)
[year image]

* Asia Leaders Awards Honouree - Company of the Year: Services

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

## Authorized Inspector.com

## Website Dedicated to the ASME & NBBI: Inspection & Knowledge

## Home To The AI Hall Of Fame

Welcome back to **Authorized Inspector**, Were Back and With a Purpose – This website has its roots
in the support of the commissioned inspectors and their role in the manufacture of the ASME pressure

#### [Hall of Fame][85]

Authorized Inspector (AI) Hall of Fame, a prestigious institution dedicated to recognizing the
outstanding contributions of Authorized Inspectors (AI) in the field of ASME Boiler and Pressure
Vessel (BPV) Codes. 

[ Nominate an AI ][86]

We are excited to announce that the Authorized Inspector (AI) Hall of Fame will be accepting
nominations for new inductees, with one Authorized Inspector (AI) being honored each quarter.
Visitors to our website will have the opportunity to vote for their favorite nominees, and the AI
with the most votes will be inducted into the Hall of Fame. Nominations will be open year-round, and
every three months, a new AI will join this prestigious community of industry leaders. This is your
chance to recognize and celebrate the exceptional contributions of those who have demonstrated
unwavering dedication to the ASME BPV Codes and the safety of critical systems worldwide. Your vote
matters—help us honor the heroes who continue to shape the future of engineering excellence. 

This Hall of Fame honors those individuals whose dedication, expertise, and commitment to
maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality have had a profound impact on the industry.
Through their work, these exceptional professionals ensure that pressure vessel and boiler systems
remain safe, efficient, and reliable, safeguarding both people and infrastructure around the world.
Their unwavering dedication and expertise not only uphold the integrity of critical systems but also
inspire future generations of inspectors to continue the vital mission of protecting lives and
advancing engineering excellence.

opportunity for exchanging information and developing innovations and the latest products from the
shipbuilding and shipyard industry. With more than 2,200 exhibitors and around 48,000 trade visitors
from all over the world, SMM continues to hold its position as the world's leading trade fair for
the marine industry.

Food Industry

Heavy Machinery Industry

Automotive Manufacturing Industry

stamping, welding, painting, assembly, and surface treatment. These operations are essential in
vehicle body manufacturing and component production, often operating in continuous and large-scale

Chemical Industry

reaction, separation, distillation, blending, and storage. These processes are widely used in the
manufacturing of basic chemicals, fine chemicals, intermediates, and specialty chemicals.
Coating & Painting Industry
The coating and painting industry involves surface finishing processes such as spray painting,
powder coating, baking, drying, and surface pretreatment. These processes are widely used in
automotive parts, metal products, machinery, and consumer goods manufacturing to improve appearance,
durability, and corrosion resistance.

ammonia emerging as one of the key future marine fuels. As ammonia-fueled engines become more widely

startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

# Innovating Drug Delivery, Together

## ExtruPharm works with pharma and biotech innovators to design and manufacture advanced
## polymer-based drug delivery systems — from early concepts to clinical-ready prototypes and
## beyond.

[ Work With Us ][9]

## ExtruPharm Provides a Variety of Design and manufacturing Services

Our team brings together expertise in extrusion, injection molding, and custom polymer processing to
design, develop, and refine advanced drug delivery devices. Every project is approached with
precision and innovation to ensure that each device meets the most rigorous performance, quality
standards, and the demanding specifications of each client.

[[Research and development images of various drug delivery devices]][10]

### [Research and Development][11]

Prototype Development

[[manufacturing]][12]

### [Manufacturing Services][13]

From Prototypes to Scalable Processes

[[Analytical Services tech holding vials for analyzing]][14]

### [Analytical Services][15]

Turning Data Into Decisions

[ View all services ][16]

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Why Choose ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is built around flexibility, technical depth, and cost-effectiveness. We are an ideal
partner for pharmaceutical and biotech companies seeking innovative solutions without unnecessary
overhead.

### Cost-Effective Development

Our rates are typically a fraction of larger CDMOs, allowing you to conserve budget for clinical
manufacturing.

### IP Protection

You retain full ownership of your intellectual property. All work performed is yours to transfer,
scale, or commercialize without restrictions

### Scalable & Transferable

Every process we design is built to be transferable — whether to a GMP CDMO of your choosing or to
one of ExtruPharm’s strategic partners.

### Agile & Responsive

As a small, specialized company, we move quickly, provide direct access to experts, and adapt to
your program’s unique needs.

### Custom Solutions

From modifying processes to designing equipment, we go beyond off-the-shelf solutions to ensure your
project’s success

### Industry Connections

Our strong relationships with leading equipment and material suppliers give you access to the right
resources, at the right time.

## About ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in the
development of polymer-based drug delivery devices

Since 2018, we have been helping companies bring complex ideas to life through expertise in
extrusion technologies, injection molding, and custom device engineering. Our focus is on creating
drug-eluting implants, parenteral devices, and combination products that improve patient outcomes
through controlled drug release.

In 2025, ExtruPharm expanded into a new 5,500 sq. ft. R&D facility in Auburn, Massachusetts,
enabling us to deliver analytical support and scalable prototype manufacturing with seamless
pathways toward GMP production through tech transfer partnerships.

We work with clients of all sizes — from startups to established pharmaceutical companies and
Universities — to deliver innovative solutions that are flexible, cost-effective, and tailored to
your program’s needs.

Applying for a grant? ExtruPharm is ideally situated to help with flat-fee services to keep you in
budget and meeting your grant timelines and deliverables.

# Hello, we’re Hempel

We help you protect your most valuable assets with our high-quality coatings

###### Hello MyHempel

## Make your coating purchasing smoother than ever

Turn your coating purchasing truly digital with MyHempel. Everything you need to select, order and
access key information about your coatings – all in one platform.
[Explore MyHempel][1]
[Visual of Hello MyHempel][Visual of Hello MyHempel]

Dive into Possibilities

Learn more about Hempel's diverse coating solutions. Filter products, access information sheets, and
elevate your projects with ease.

Find the right coating

selector and find the right coating system.

Try it now

experience.

## Welcome To IRA

### Advanced Technologies for a Better Tomorrow

**Ira** has been delivering professional engineering solutions to the oil, gas, petrochemical,
chemical, and water industries for nearly 40 years. We specialize in the design, fabrication, and
installation of advanced turnkey systems for process equipment, pressure vessels, and heat
exchangers.

In addition to our environmentally conscious products—such as wet scrubbers, silencers, and emission
control systems—we also meet custom requirements for storage tanks, pressure vessels, and heat
exchangers, ensuring tailored solutions for diverse industrial applications.

### Precision Manufacturing & Custom Fabrication

Since its foundation, IRA’s quality policy has been rooted in the commitment to deliver superior
products and services to both national and international markets. Our dedication to excellence
drives every stage of our operations, ensuring consistent quality, compliance, and customer
satisfaction.

### Integrated In-House Engineering Expertise

At IRA, all engineering processes are managed in-house by our experienced team of specialists. From
conceptual design to detailed analysis and technical documentation, we ensure full control,
flexibility, and seamless coordination across all stages of project development. This integrated
approach guarantees tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards.

### Quality Management System

At IRA, our Quality Management System ensures that a wide range of products—such as storage tanks,
pressure vessels, pipeline and pigging systems, process vessels, heat exchangers, filtration and
scrubber systems, and blow-off silencers—are all engineered and produced in-house by our
multidisciplinary team. Every step is governed by strict quality controls to meet international
standards and deliver long-lasting performance.

### IRA Products

At İRA Engineering, we manufacture high-quality and reliable equipment for industrial facilities.
Our product range includes pressure vessels, heat exchangers, steam boilers, piping spool systems,
environmental vehicles, multi-purpose units, surge separation filter vessels, as well as large-scale
ducting and air transfer solutions. By adhering to engineering standards in both design and
production, we deliver tailored solutions for each project. With a focus on durability, efficiency,
and safety, our products meet the diverse needs of various industries.

Kuer Environmental Technology is a national high-tech enterprise and provincial-level specialized

company is committed to developing and producing efficient and environmentally friendly cleaning
equipment, providing users with professional cleaning solutions.

impact caused by manual cleaning, and promote the cleaning industry towards a more environmentally
friendly and intelligent future.

Cleaning Equipment R&D

[ CONTACT US  ][75]
* Cleaning Equipment Production
  The company is located at No. 19, Xiangpu Road, Taohua Town, Feixi County, Hefei City, Anhui
  Province, with a production area of approximately 20,000 square meters. It currently produces
  2,000 units of cleaning and sweeping equipment per month.
* OEM And ODM Services
  The company boasts strong R&D and production capabilities, a professional technical team, and
  advanced production equipment. We can provide customized OEM and ODM services for cleaning
  equipment to meet the individual needs of our customers.
* Equipment Sales And Service
  The company's products are sold nationwide and internationally. Its floor scrubbers and sweepers
  utilize external suction, straight-cylinder filtration and an automatic cleaning system,
  integrating water spraying, sweeping, and suction. They are highly efficient, leave no marks, and
  are easy to operate. They have been used in locations such as the JAC Motors factory and Metro
  supermarkets.
* After-Sales Service
  Free repair service is provided, with on-site repairs within one year from the date of purchase
  (excluding consumable parts). At least three follow-up visits will be made within one year of
  purchase to monitor equipment usage and provide support. The company also maintains a nationwide
  service network, providing customers with a "one-stop" solution for consultation and equipment
  repairs.

With over 150 years of combined expertise, the LDX brands—Dustex®, Geoenergy®, and Western
Pneumatics®—lead the industry in delivering tailored solutions that provide our clients with a
competitive edge. We are a trusted partner ensuring air emission regulatory compliance while
minimizing operational impact for thousands of facilities across the U.S. As a full-service
provider, LDX Solutions integrates custom design and engineering with cutting-edge technologies and
top-tier quality to deliver turnkey solutions that offer our clients the highest performance at the
lowest cost over the lifetime of their equipment.

[The vertical scrubber]

### The vertical scrubber

## Optimizing Gas Cleaning with the Vertical Scrubber: A Revolutionary Approach to Hydrochloric Acid
## Vapor Recovery

The vertical scrubber is a column in which the gas is absorbed directly by means of a counter
current spray system to irrigate random packings. The vapor enters at the bottom through half a pipe

# clean when it leaves —

## Lechler designs bespoke wet scrubber installations that capture harmful gas emissions before they
## reach the atmosphere, paired with precision analysers that continuously measure and verify what's
## released — proven across chemical, maritime, and heavy industry.

Trusted across
Chemical & process Maritime Power & energy Heavy industry
Part of the Lechler Group

## A new chapter,
## the same commitment.

After many years of activity in Brielle in the fields of analytical technology and gas scrubber
systems, these solutions are now offered by Lechler Process Technology B.V., a newly established and
independent company that is part of the Lechler Group.

Several specialists with extensive experience in these applications have joined our team, bringing
valuable application knowledge and customer understanding. Combined with the strength, stability and
international capabilities of the Lechler Group, this makes us a **strong and reliable partner** for
analytical applications and scrubber-related process solutions.

Lechler places great importance on the responsible and efficient use of resources. We look closely
at customer processes, especially where water, chemicals and energy are used, and work together with
customers to improve them in a sustainable way. We would be glad to support you going forward with
the same commitment, now backed by the broader capabilities of the Lechler Group.

Are you facing any challenges? Get in touch with us
Contact
[The vertical scrubber]

### The vertical scrubber

## Optimizing Gas Cleaning with the Vertical Scrubber: A Revolutionary Approach to Hydrochloric Acid
## Vapor Recovery

The vertical scrubber is a column in which the gas is absorbed directly by means of a counter
current spray system to irrigate random packings. The vapor enters at the bottom through half a pipe
to obtain a laminar airflow. The random packings (Pall rings) increase the contact area, with the
aim of creating a better absorption process between the gas and the washing medium. The spray nozzle
to flush the packings is a non-clogging full cone type.

[Scrubbers]

### Scrubbers

## Tailored Scrubbing Solutions for Every Need

At Lechlerscrubber.com, we realize that understanding your specific operational demands is the first
step towards providing the optimal scrubbing solution. Our dedicated team works closely with you to
understand the precise challenges faced by your operation, from the type of pollutants involved to
the size and the particle or chemical load of the gas flow. We evaluate these aspects in depth,
allowing us to recommend a scrubber system that is most suitable for your unique application. Our
scrubbers come in varying designs and absorption systems, each with its unique strengths and
specialized applications, to ensure optimal performance and efficiency.

[Solutions]

### Solutions

## Innovative Solutions for Complex Challenges

We pride ourselves on our ability to deliver cutting-edge solutions designed to meet the intricate
needs of diverse industrial settings. Understanding that each operation is unique, we've developed a
range of scrubbers, offering varying configurations and absorption systems to ensure optimal
purification. From open spray systems to packed towers scrubbers, our solutions are built to tackle
specific challenges, ensuring the highest level of performance. Explore our 'Solutions' tab to
discover how our innovative scrubber systems can enhance your operation's efficiency and
environmental sustainability.

[Industry]

### Industry

## Empowering Industries Worldwide

We are dedicated to providing advanced solutions that cater to a multitude of industrial sectors
worldwide. Our scrubbers are designed with the challenges of various industries in mind, from power
generation and chemical production, to food industry and more. Our knowledge and experience in these
sectors allow us to craft industrial scrubbers that not only ensure effective gas purification but
also support smoother, safer, and more efficient operations.

[Application]

### Application

## Targeted Applications for Every Industry

We understand that each industry comes with its unique challenges and requirements. This is why
we've improved our expertise to offer targeted applications suitable for a wide array of industries.
Whether you're dealing chemical pollutants, odor nuisance in gas flows or looking to increase your
operation's efficiency, our industrial scrubbers provide tailored solutions. With extensive industry
knowledge and technical skill, we design scrubbers for specific applications, ensuring optimal
performance and utmost reliability. Explore our application tab to discover how our scrubbers can be
the key to your operation's sustainability and efficiency.

[Game-changing benefits]

Game-changing benefits

Discover the game-changing benefits of scrubbers and propel your business forward with our free
whitepaper download.

[ Request our whitepaper ][74]
[Understanding Scrubber Constructions]

### Understanding Scrubber Constructions

## A Comprehensive Guide

Explore the intricacies of scrubber constructions in this comprehensive guide. Delve into the
specifics of vane type separators, wire mesh demisters, open spray systems, hollow and full cone
nozzles, and packed bed scrubbers. Understand the unique features and applications of these systems,
essential for efficient gas and particulate separation in industrial settings. Gain insights into
the engineering and operational principles behind these advanced environmental technologies.

For detailed information, you can visit the webpage [here][75].
[Completed Projects]

### Completed Projects

## Explore Our Project Matrix

Visit our Completed Projects page, where you can explore a selection of our successfully executed
projects. Our interactive matrix showcases various types of scrubbers including gas scrubbers, dust
scrubbers, and odor scrubbers. This matrix is organized by industry, process, emission type, and
other key parameters, providing a comprehensive overview of our expertise and capabilities.

Whether you are interested in aeronautics, chemicals, food processing, or green energy, you will
find detailed information on how our customized solutions effectively address specific environmental
challenges. Each entry includes the type of scrubber used, the materials involved, and the process
analyzers implemented, illustrating our commitment to tailored, efficient, and sustainable
solutions. Dive into the matrix to see how we have helped clients across diverse industries achieve
cleaner emissions and improved environmental compliance.
[See it for yourself][76]

### Seeing is Believing

## A Showcase of Our Expertise and Innovation

We hold a strong belief in showcasing tangible proof of our ability to solve complex problems and
create unique solutions. It's in this section - "Seeing is Believing" - where we proudly present our
realized projects. Each one is a testament to our expertise, innovation, and the effectiveness of
our industrial scrubbers in removing water-soluble inorganic pollutants.

Whether it's a countercurrent, cross-current, or co-current scrubber configuration, we have time and
again proved our competency and proficiency. From packed towers and tray columns to open-spray
columns, our broad range of solutions demonstrates our commitment to quality, efficiency, and
environmental responsibility.

Step into our world and see the transformation we bring through our sophisticated and carefully
calibrated gas purification systems. Your journey into a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable
industrial operation begins here.

## **Engineering Excellence**

#### Since 1995

### ****
### **About Us**
### ****

Matrix Engineering provides a wide range of consulting engineering services to industrial clients.
 We are comprised of dedicated, hard-working engineers who thrive on both creativity and innovation
along with implementing proven experience and sound judgement.  Our success depends upon the success
of our clients and we truly understand that objective by fostering long term relationships.

Our sister firm is called Matrix Industrial Systems Inc., through which we can take our designs from
paper to reality.  Our systems division provides equipment and control systems to industrial and
marine clients.  Our goal is seamless implementation of our designs through providing a complete
system package with capabilities for maintenance and emergency service calls.

### **Our Services**

[Matrix Engineering Consulting Services]

##### Consulting Engineering 

Matrix Engineering has a strong industrial background with expertise in handling some of the most
difficult powders found in the chemical industry.
[Matrix Industrial Systems]

##### System Provider

Our systems division has provided our patented pulverized DENSI-FEED® fuel system to paper mills
across the country and deep into the heart of India. Matrix has also developed a revolutionary new
hot water system called THERMO-DIVE™ for divers in a cold water environment with sales stretching as
far as Australia. 
[Matrix Engineering - Industrial Marine Control Systems]

##### Industrial/Marine Control Systems

Matrix builds our own control systems in specialty areas for bulk material handling, manufacturing
processes, robotics, large compressors and inland towboats. One recent innovative control system
called TUGMONITOR™ helps towboats and tugs meet new Coast Guard requirements for alarm systems in
the marine industry.
[Matrix Engineering - Darren Jarvis, Owner]

##### "At Matrix Engineering, our team can both see the big picture and sweat the details that make
##### any project successful! We are dedicated to serving clients in the Chemical, Pulp and Paper,
##### Power, Manufacturing, and Marine Industry in the US and around the world.”

**Darren Jarvis, Owner**

## **Engineering Excellence**

#### Since 1995

### ****
### **About Us**
### ****

Matrix Engineering provides a wide range of consulting engineering services to industrial clients.
 We are comprised of dedicated, hard-working engineers who thrive on both creativity and innovation
along with implementing proven experience and sound judgement.  Our success depends upon the success
of our clients and we truly understand that objective by fostering long term relationships.

Our sister firm is called Matrix Industrial Systems Inc., through which we can take our designs from
paper to reality.  Our systems division provides equipment and control systems to industrial and
marine clients.  Our goal is seamless implementation of our designs through providing a complete
system package with capabilities for maintenance and emergency service calls.

### **Our Services**

[Matrix Engineering Consulting Services]

##### Consulting Engineering 

Matrix Engineering has a strong industrial background with expertise in handling some of the most
difficult powders found in the chemical industry.
[Matrix Industrial Systems]

##### System Provider

Our systems division has provided our patented pulverized DENSI-FEED® fuel system to paper mills
across the country and deep into the heart of India. Matrix has also developed a revolutionary new
hot water system called THERMO-DIVE™ for divers in a cold water environment with sales stretching as
far as Australia. 
[Matrix Engineering - Industrial Marine Control Systems]

##### Industrial/Marine Control Systems

Matrix builds our own control systems in specialty areas for bulk material handling, manufacturing
processes, robotics, large compressors and inland towboats. One recent innovative control system
called TUGMONITOR™ helps towboats and tugs meet new Coast Guard requirements for alarm systems in
the marine industry.
[Matrix Engineering - Darren Jarvis, Owner]

##### "At Matrix Engineering, our team can both see the big picture and sweat the details that make
##### any project successful! We are dedicated to serving clients in the Chemical, Pulp and Paper,
##### Power, Manufacturing, and Marine Industry in the US and around the world.”

**Darren Jarvis, Owner**

# Cleaner Oceans Start With Smarter Engineering

Our sustainable maritime solutions are built to lower emissions and raise performance - across gear,
scrubber, and heat recovery systems.

[ CONTACT US ][23]

## Welcome to ME Production

At ME Production, we deliver sustainable, high-performance solutions to the maritime industry –
built on more than 50 years of Danish engineering expertise. From SOx scrubber systems and hybrid
gear to waste heat recovery via heat pumps, we help you reduce emissions, boost energy efficiency,
and improve long-term profitability.

We manage complete projects from idea to installation, including design, production, commissioning,
and service – always tailored to your vessel’s needs. With global reach and local service hubs,
we’re ready to support you wherever you operate.

Choose ME Production – and move your operations toward a cleaner, smarter future.

### Innovative engineering

We also help customers develop, produce, and engineer technology in either their own or our designs.

Do you have plans to reduce your emissions and create cleaner air? 

ME Productions’ Innovation Team is ready to assist, bringing our capabilities into play to help you
meet your environmental goals and targets through the development of new technologies.

[ READ MORE ][25]

### Efficient service solutions

Our service is here to help you ensure that your vessel is not only environmentally responsible but
also efficient and profitable. Secure your vessel's profitability and the planet's well being.

Contact us today to discover how our service can transform your marine operations. Let's work
together to create a cleaner, greener, and more profitable voyage.

# NICKEL-BASED ALLOYS MANUFACTURING

## WHY CHOOSE NICRO?

For over 40 years **NICRO** has been working in the development and fabrication of components in
**steel alloys** with **high nickel content**, particularly suitable for high temperatures and
corrosive environments used in different industrial applications.

Our **skilled technical staff** and a know-how acquired in the manufacturing of **custom-made**
components enable us to help customers in the very early stage of prototyping and construction
drawing development. We also collaborate to suggest modifications to reach **better performances and
a long lasting life, through the research in alternative materials**. On the other side our
technical department can do **reverse engineering** in case of used components that does not have a
construction drawing.

**NICRO** is certified **ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 50001:2018** by
**IQNet** and **Quality Austria**, **ISO 3834-2:2021** by **IIS CERT**.

investments and projects.

# NICKEL-BASED ALLOYS MANUFACTURING

## WHY CHOOSE NICRO?

For over 40 years **NICRO** has been working in the development and fabrication of components in
**steel alloys** with **high nickel content**, particularly suitable for high temperatures and
corrosive environments used in different industrial applications.

Our **skilled technical staff** and a know-how acquired in the manufacturing of **custom-made**
components enable us to help customers in the very early stage of prototyping and construction
drawing development. We also collaborate to suggest modifications to reach **better performances and
a long lasting life, through the research in alternative materials**. On the other side our
technical department can do **reverse engineering** in case of used components that does not have a
construction drawing.

**NICRO** is certified **ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 50001:2018** by
**IQNet** and **Quality Austria**, **ISO 3834-2:2021** by **IIS CERT**.

[Discover Why choose Nicro][47]

## SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Investing in innovation, for Nicro, means having the most advanced technology, a team of experts
that is constantly trained, but also a fundamental attention to sustainability. Every year in the
social balance sheet, the company highlights environmental, social and resource management
investments and projects.

What is StudyX? expand_more
StudyX is an all-in-one AI study platform designed to help students learn more effectively. It

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is StudyX? expand_more
StudyX is an all-in-one AI study platform designed to help students learn more effectively. It
combines AI study tools such as homework help, notes generation, flashcards, quizzes, and writing
support in one place.
How does StudyX help students study with AI? expand_more
StudyX helps students study with AI throughout the entire learning journey. Students can use it to
get homework help, turn lectures and study materials into notes, generate flashcards and quizzes for
exam preparation, and improve writing with AI-powered tools. By combining multiple AI study tools in
one platform, StudyX supports different learning needs—from daily homework and classroom learning to
exam prep and professional training—making it useful for students of all ages and learning stages.
What subjects can StudyX's AI study tools help with? expand_more
StudyX supports 50+ subjects including math, science, history, economics, and more, helping students
solve problems and generate study materials across different topics.
Is StudyX a free AI study platform? expand_more
Yes, please go ahead and try StudyX for free. StudyX offers free access to many AI study tools. If
you're interested in exploring additional features or getting extended learning help, you can also
choose StudyX's cost-friendly subscription plans.
What is the best AI study tool for students? expand_more
The best AI study tool helps students understand concepts, organize study materials, and practice
what they learn. StudyX combines homework help, AI notes, flashcards, quizzes, and writing tools in
one AI study platform, making it easier for students to study more efficiently. Besides StudyX,
Turbo AI, Studley, NotebookLM, StudyFetch, and Mindgrasp can also be good choices.
Can AI tools help with exam preparation? expand_more
AI study tools such as StudyX can support exam preparation by generating practice quizzes,
summarizing key topics, and creating flashcards from study materials. These features help students
review information and reinforce what they have learned before tests.
Are AI study tools suitable for all ages? expand_more
AI study platforms like StudyX are designed to support students across different learning stages,
from middle school and high school to university and professional training. Tools like StudyX can
adapt to different subjects, learning levels, and study goals.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

# Production of Industrial Air Cleaning and Filtering Equipment

[ Baghouse Dust Collectors ][74]
Dry dust collectors. Pulse cleaning, vibration cleaning, mechanical cleaning, and cyclone inlet.
[ Wet Scrubbers ][75]
Wet dust collectors. Attachment-type, hollow, with droplet collectors, foam gas scrubbers.
[ Cartridge Dust Collectors ][76]
Dry dust collectors. They are distinguished by their compact size due to the use of cassette filter
elements.
[ Silo Filters ][77]
Air filters for air purification from silos. We manufacture cartridge filters, baghouses, and pocket
filters.
[ Kitchen Pollution Control Units ][78]
TORCH-AIR pollution control unit (PCU) or spark arrester are designed to purify air from sparks,
smoke, odors, soot particles, grease, and ash.
[ Adsorbers and Dry Scrubbers ][79]
Absorb carbon dioxide from the air in tanks with clean water (at the inlet) or in containers where
chemical compounds are stored.
[ Portable Collectors ][80]
Mobile compact filters for local extraction of workplaces.
[ Oil Mist Collectors ][81]
Effective air purification from smoke, oil mist, oil vapors, emulsions, aerosols.

Torch-Air designs and manufactures both wet and dry air pollution control systems and combines them
into a single integrated solution when the application demands it. This is where our engineering
expertise delivers the greatest value.

In demanding metallurgical and chemical processes, for example, a wet scrubbing stage is often used
first for gas cooling and bulk contaminant removal. A dry filtration stage then provides final
polishing, achieving up to 99.9% particulate removal efficiency.

## For the Sake of Our Environment and Our Clients, We Offer the Best Conditions Possible

We Customize Installations to Suit Your Company
For instance, we can design a filter to be mobile or to suit specific size. We’ll help spare you the
hassle of a long and cumbersome project with additional equipment — a long air duct, more powerful
fan, and compressor.
Seamless Operation and Servicing
Straight-forward, fool-proof replacement of filtration element and filter management systems.
Everything is done with the help of modern relays, logic controllers, and under generally accepted
norms.
Easy Installation
Whether on your own or with the help of our team.
Semi knocked down assembly is performed based on instructions, such as in furniture assembly. The
installation service is available for time-saving purposes.
We Render Production Sites More Environment and Employee-Friendly
We help ensure that production sites all over the world reduce the negative impact they have on the
environment. Our cleaning systems help minimize harmful waste.
Up to 99.99% Air Cleaning
Collected case data confirm up to 99.9% cleaning. This data is confirmed by lab tests and
certificates.
We choose the gas flow speed so that the gas flows as slowly as possible. This helps minimize the
load on the filter frame and wear abrasion.
20-Year Service Life
2-Year Warranty
We Offer to Help Our Clients Achieve Their Objectives in a Customized Fashion

## For the Sake of Our Environment and Our Clients, We Offer the Best Conditions Possible

We Customize Installations to Suit Your Company
For instance, we can design a filter to be mobile or to suit specific size. We’ll help spare you the
hassle of a long and cumbersome project with additional equipment — a long air duct, more powerful
fan, and compressor.
Seamless Operation and Servicing
Straight-forward, fool-proof replacement of filtration element and filter management systems.
Everything is done with the help of modern relays, logic controllers, and under generally accepted
norms.
Easy Installation
Whether on your own or with the help of our team.
Semi knocked down assembly is performed based on instructions, such as in furniture assembly. The
installation service is available for time-saving purposes.
We Render Production Sites More Environment and Employee-Friendly
We help ensure that production sites all over the world reduce the negative impact they have on the
environment. Our cleaning systems help minimize harmful waste.
Up to 99.99% Air Cleaning
Collected case data confirm up to 99.9% cleaning. This data is confirmed by lab tests and
certificates.
We choose the gas flow speed so that the gas flows as slowly as possible. This helps minimize the
load on the filter frame and wear abrasion.

provider that was established in 2018. TMST identified a gap within the Northern Tasmanian market
for a business to offer a purposely designed vessel to conduct towage, salvage, dredging, and
general workboat duties. Solutions. TMST acquired our primary vessel, 'Beattie', in 2017, a
purpose-built shallow draft, compact, high bollard pull tug capable of offering a versatile platform
for a vast array of marine operations. Since conception, TMST has provided solutions for Clients
undertaking historical, high-value project within Tasmania. TMST is proud to offer local content,
high specification vessels, and provide local professionals that together bolster the core
fundamentals of Total Marine Solutions Tasmania. 


TMST company directors work within the Australian maritime industry and have 30+ years combined

qualifications, and experience working with some of the largest local and international maritime

the best efficiency from our operation whilst providing the Tasmanian-based market with unmatched
professionalism, vast industry knowledge, and high-level compliance.

fundamentals of Total Marine Solutions Tasmania.

experience within the industry. This team has a unique combination of skills, knowledge,
qualifications, and experience working with some of the largest local and international maritime

the best efficiency from our operation whilst providing the Tasmanian-based market with unmatched

Hazell Bros - Berth 4 West Fender Replacment

Total Dive Solutions (TDS)

mooring solution for the 32-meter barge.

Harry O'May Resecuring Works

ADEC Kedge Marine Surveyors

interaction with the foundered derelict tug 'Cape Bruny'. TMST was engaged to undertake an initial
survey and report back to the client with a plan for rescuing the vessel. TMST opted to install a
shore-based ground anchor system as a solution for replacing the existing compromised timber piles,
providing a long-term mooring Solution.

Total Dive Solutions (TDS) - Emu River Rail Bridge

We source high-quality products including marine fuel across multiple grades, bio-blends and offset

expanding range of decarbonisation solutions. Our product offering includes:

### Compliance

### LNG

A global network

#### Spanning five continents, our customers have access to a secure supply of stable product

Our operations are built upon a leased and proprietary network of physical refineries, storage
facilities and barges.

Strategically located blending facilities at key trading and bunkering hubs mean we can provide
bespoke specifications to meet our customers’ requirements.

Video

### Why use co-processed fuel to power your vessels?

In a world of increasingly complex decarbonisation regulation, co-processed, sustainability attached
VLSFO and LSMGO (co-pro) provides a compliant, familiar and simple solution for ship owners and
operators.

Our animated explainer dives deeper into Vitol’s co-processed, sustainability attached, and
regulatory compliant fuel.

Watch video
Case study

### Decarbonising shipping

Shipping is an integral part of international trade flows with over 80% of international trade
volumes carried by sea. To address this, the International Maritime Organisation has laid out
targets to entirely eliminate all shipping emissions by the end of the century with a shorter-term
target to halve total emissions by 2050. The EU has also set its own targets of a 55% reduction in
emissions by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2050.

[Read case study][11]
Insight

### FuelEU Maritime; what it means for shipping

The Fuel EU Maritime is the latest EU regulation aimed at the maritime sector, which came into force
on the 1st of January 2025. It is part of the European Union’s broader “Fit for 55” package of
legislation, which aims to reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to
1990 levels and achieve climate neutrality by 2050. Fuel EU Maritime is designed to incentivise the
uptake of lower-carbon alternative fuels in vessels by penalising the use of most conventional
fossil-based marine fuels.

[Read Vitol's insight][12]

Global solutions

#### Meeting the world’s critical and emerging energy needs

Serving the energy markets for almost six decades, today, Vitol has operations across every
continent where colleagues work collaboratively from over 40 offices to deliver energy solutions for
our customers.

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.
